new_exact_v1_reviews.title: RAG-DIVE: A Dynamic Approach for Multi-Turn Dialogue Evaluation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using static multi-turn datasets fails to capture the dynamic nature of real-world dialogues.
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: Existing evaluation methods rely on predefined datasets, which restrict them to static, one-directional queries and limit their ability to capture the adaptive, context-dependent performance of RAG systems in interactive, multi-turn settings.
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: Thus, we introduce the RAG-DIVE, a Dynamic Interactive Validation and Evaluation approach, that simulates user interactions with RAG systems.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: Existing evaluation methods rely on predefined datasets, which restrict them to static, one-directional queries and limit their ability to capture the adaptive, context-dependent performance of RAG systems in interactive, multi-turn settings.
new_exact_v1_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Evidence is author-reported exact-v1 mechanism/evaluation evidence. It does not establish cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-workload or production generality unless those conditions are explicitly named above.
new_exact_v1_reviews.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a rapidly growing area of research that addresses key limitations of large language models (LLMs), such as hallucination and restricted knowledge scope ( Lewis et al., 2021 ) .
new_exact_v1_reviews.coexistence_boundary: The older path remains appropriate where its workload and SLO do not trigger the changed constraint; the paper is treated as a conditional branch, not a universal replacement.

new_exact_v1_reviews.title: BrainMem: Brain-Inspired Evolving Memory for Embodied Agent Task Planning
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Embodied task planning requires agents to execute long-horizon, goal-directed actions in complex 3D environments, where success depends on both immediate perception and accumulated experience across tasks.
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: However, most existing LLM-based planners are stateless and reactive, operating without persistent memory and therefore repeating errors and struggling with spatial or temporal dependencies.
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: We propose BrainMem(Brain-Inspired Evolving Memory), a training-free hierarchical memory system that equips embodied agents with working, episodic, and semantic memory inspired by human cognition.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: Extensive experiments on four representative benchmarks, including EB-ALFRED, EB-Navigation, EB-Manipulation, and EB-Habitat, demonstrate that BrainMem significantly enhances task success rates across diverse models and difficulty subsets, with the largest gains observed on long-horizon and spatially complex tasks.
new_exact_v1_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Evidence is author-reported exact-v1 mechanism/evaluation evidence. It does not establish cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-workload or production generality unless those conditions are explicitly named above.
new_exact_v1_reviews.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Failure Case 1: “Place a cleaned sponge in a bathtub” Find a faucet Turn on faucet Turn off faucet Failure reason: The agent loses short-term context and keeps toggling the faucet, unaware the sponge is still held.
new_exact_v1_reviews.coexistence_boundary: The older path remains appropriate where its workload and SLO do not trigger the changed constraint; the paper is treated as a conditional branch, not a universal replacement.

new_exact_v1_reviews.title: Cross-Family Speculative Decoding for Polish Language Models on Apple~Silicon: An Empirical Evaluation of Bielik~11B with UAG-Extended MLX-LM
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by using a small draft model to propose k candidate tokens for a target model to verify.
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: Privacy is not the only pressure, however.
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: We propose a hardware-aware speedup formula and characterize conditions for cross-family speculative decoding on Apple Silicon.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: We evaluate Bielik 11B-Instruct (Mistral-based) as the target model, paired with three draft models: Bielik 1.5B (Qwen-based with custom tokenizer), Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama 3.2-1B.

new_exact_v1_reviews.title: Stream2LLM: Overlap Context Streaming and Prefill for Reduced TTFT
new_exact_v1_reviews.problem: Context retrieval systems for LLM inference face a critical challenge: high retrieval latency creates a fundamental tension between waiting for complete context (poor time-to-first-token) and proceeding without it (reduced quality).
new_exact_v1_reviews.old_path_and_changed_constraint: Context retrieval systems for LLM inference face a critical challenge: high retrieval latency creates a fundamental tension between waiting for complete context (poor time-to-first-token) and proceeding without it (reduced quality).
new_exact_v1_reviews.mechanism_and_ownership: We present Stream2LLM, a streaming-aware LLM serving system for concurrent prefill-decode disaggregated deployments.
new_exact_v1_reviews.evaluation_contract: Our evaluation demonstrates that streaming architecture delivers up to 11x TTFT improvements, with cost-aware scheduling providing critical benefits under memory pressure, all while maintaining throughput parity with non-streaming baselines.
new_exact_v1_reviews.proof_and_nonproof: Evidence is author-reported exact-v1 mechanism/evaluation evidence. It does not establish cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-workload or production generality unless those conditions are explicitly named above.
new_exact_v1_reviews.tradeoffs_and_failure_modes: Naive approaches that treat all streaming requests uniformly suffer from either poor scheduling decisions or excessive cache recomputation overhead.
